description: Render a degraded copy of one document and return it: a flatbed scan, a fax, a phone photo or a low-resolution copy (preset), as an image-only PDF with the specimen band and watermark drawn on top of the degraded pages. The settings come from the seed and are recorded in the ground truth (degradation, degradationParams); the fields are those of the clean document. Returns page images (as many as fit), the ground truth, and the PDF itself when include_pdf is set and it fits. No file is saved.

from_page.description: first page to return as an image (default 1)

include_pdf.description: also return the degraded PDF itself; it counts toward the same size limit as the page images and is left out, with a note, when it alone is over it

layout_variant.description: Optional. A layout variant id from this document type's published list, or seeded to pick one from the seed. Applies only to itemized-bill, ppo-eob and hmo-eob. Leave it out for the standard layout, unchanged. The answer key records which variant was used.

preset.description: scan (flatbed scan), fax (black and white, standard or fine), photo (phone photo of the page on a table) or low-res

preview.description: pages returned as images: none, the first (from from_page), or all from from_page on, as many as fit in one result (default all)

seed.description: any short string (letters, digits, . _ -); the same seed always gives the same document

type.description: document type: msn, itemized-bill, ppo-eob, hmo-eob

name: degrade_document
title: Render a scanned-looking copy of a document
